preservation.rule: v0.1.0 is never edited in place; v0.1.1 is a new package with its own fixtures, digest and version stamp
preservation.record_rule: saved v0.1.0 decisions keep their version stamp and stay readable beside v0.1.1

ice_contract.transform: previous eligible London 05:00 fixing to latest London 05:00 fixing received at or before the cutoff, simple return in percent

clocks.observed_at_utc: the 05:00 Europe/London fixing instant of the fixing used
clocks.published_at_utc: the publisher's recorded release stamp for that fixing, at or before the cutoff
clocks.received_at_utc: the collector's receipt, required, at or before the cutoff

preserved_invariants: the observation is a 05:00 London fixing, not an intraday print
two distinct fixings are required; a repeated fixing blocks instead of scoring 0.00 per cent
no fill, carry-forward, interpolation, proxy or neighbour
the broker DXY proxy stays refused
the other eight inputs keep their own caps
readiness is not diluted: no morning becomes eligible without a licensed fixing record

structural_finding.schedule: 145 complete Monday-to-Friday weeks; gap histogram 579 x 1 day and 145 x 3 days; no holiday gaps
structural_finding.consequence: a 24 hour maximum age excludes every Monday and every post-holiday morning, so option B (96 hours) is the default

proposals.title: ICE 05:00 timing: receive by the cutoff, not at it
proposals.current: ice max_age_hours 0 with observed <= published <= received <= cutoff forces all three clocks onto the cutoff instant
proposals.proposed: observed and published at the 05:00 London fixing stamp, received at or before the cutoff, latest eligible fixing no older than 96 hours (option A: 24 hours), two distinct fixings

proposals.title: The front-end change is a spread operand, not a ninth gate
proposals.current: front is a standalone required input that no family reads
proposals.proposed: eight inputs plus the named operand front; the presence test moves inside the spread row
proposals.default_if_no_reply: accept the wording, defer the count change
proposals.verification: contract check reports inputs 8, operands [front], same spread value

proposals.title: The VIX row measured the level only
proposals.current: the row names level and change; the executable reads the level
proposals.proposed: retitle the row as level-only and record the change feature as a v0.2 candidate
proposals.verification: text-only patch: outputs, fixture digests and coverage counts unchanged

proposals.title: F23 calendar distance is declared but not implemented
proposals.current: two calendar rows share one count; distance has no executable representation
proposals.proposed: record F23 as unimplemented in the rulebook table, with the reason
proposals.verification: shared-evidence table shows one implemented and one declared-only feature

proposals.title: The trace's front vote is reported-only
proposals.current: votes.front sits in the trace while frontCounted is false
proposals.proposed: rename it frontReportedOnly and publish the six counted votes beside the family means
proposals.verification: regenerated v0.1.1 fixture trace; guard test over the counted set

proposals.title: A zero event count from an incomplete calendar is not evidence
proposals.current: the count is the only calendar feature; four release families are unarchived
proposals.proposed: rulebook sentence: an incomplete calendar blocks the morning instead of reporting no release
proposals.verification: rulebook row text; coverage keeps calendar in the blocker list

left_out.reason: no-fallback is a declared design choice, not a defect
thresholds are hypotheses; calibrating them is a new model, not a patch
shared evidence reducing votes is an arithmetic property of the book, already reported
the trace reading instruction is folded into P-05's legend edit

coverage_after_acceptance.why: the archive still holds no licensed ICE fixing, no LBMA PM auction and no complete release calendar; the proposals remove an impossibility, they do not add data
coverage_after_acceptance.legacy_counts_status: kept as legacy, explicitly labelled, never merged with H1
